name: PEP and High-Risk Person Laundering
description: Laundering of proceeds of corruption or other crimes by or on behalf of politically exposed persons, relatives, close associates and other high-risk individuals, often through intermediaries, companies and foreign accounts. Such flows may be integrated through property, luxury assets and investments.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance on Politically Exposed Persons (Recommendations 12 and 22) (2013)
FATF, Laundering the Proceeds of Corruption (2011)
Wolfsberg Group, Wolfsberg Guidance on Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) (2017)

indicators.name: Wealth inconsistent with official income
indicators.canon: Wealth or spending inconsistent with known means
indicators.desc: Assets, lifestyle spending or purchases clearly exceed the customer's known legitimate income or declared wealth, with no verifiable source.
indicators.ctx: Assets and flows clearly exceed the legitimate income expected for the individual's official position.
indicators.fp: Family wealth and prior career can explain.

indicators.name: Use of relatives or close associates as account holders
indicators.canon: Use of relatives or close associates as account holders
indicators.desc: Accounts or assets held by family or associates who have limited own means.
indicators.ctx: Accounts or assets held by family or associates who have limited own means.

indicators.name: Opaque structures for PEP-connected assets
indicators.canon: Passive offshore vehicle or foundation holding personal assets
indicators.desc: A foundation, shell or similar vehicle in a low-transparency jurisdiction holds an individual's investments, property or accounts without commercial purpose.
indicators.ctx: Foundations, trusts or companies hide PEP's interest.

indicators.name: Large payments from state entities or contractors
indicators.canon: Large payments from state entities or contractors
indicators.desc: Receipts from government bodies, state-owned firms or contractors linked to PEP's remit.
indicators.ctx: Receipts from government bodies, state-owned firms or contractors linked to PEP's remit.

indicators.name: Transfers to or from jurisdictions of high corruption risk
indicators.desc: Funds or wealth are linked to or transferred to and from jurisdictions with high perceived corruption.
indicators.ctx: Flows linked to countries with high corruption or secrecy.

indicators.name: Newly acquired PEP status not re-assessed
indicators.canon: Newly acquired PEP status not re-assessed
indicators.desc: Customer becomes PEP after onboarding without update.
indicators.ctx: Customer becomes PEP after onboarding without update.

indicators.name: Unusual real-estate or luxury purchases
indicators.desc: High-value purchases by PEPs or associates abroad.
indicators.ctx: High-value purchases by PEPs or associates abroad.

indicators.name: Attempts to avoid disclosure of PEP status
indicators.canon: Attempts to avoid disclosure of PEP status
indicators.desc: Customer denies or omits political role despite evidence.
indicators.ctx: Customer denies or omits political role despite evidence.

indicators.name: Use of intermediaries and agents to handle funds
indicators.canon: Use of intermediaries and agents to handle funds
indicators.desc: Lawyers, brokers or fixers move funds on behalf of PEP.
indicators.ctx: Lawyers, brokers or fixers move funds on behalf of PEP.
indicators.fp: Professionals commonly act for wealthy clients.
